Service Description
TrainZilla Platform
TrainZilla is an AI-powered fitness platform designed specifically for Indian personal trainers and their clients. Our services include:
AI-powered workout and nutrition planning tools
Client management and communication systems
Video calling and virtual training capabilities
Payment processing and subscription management
Multi-language support including Hindi and regional languages
Business analytics and reporting tools
Mobile applications for trainers and clients
User Categories
Trainers:
Certified fitness professionals who provide training services
Clients:
Individuals who receive training services through our platform
Visitors:
Users who browse our platform without creating an account
User Accounts and Registration
Account Creation
You must be at least 18 years old to create an account
You must provide accurate, current, and complete information
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account
You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use
One person may not maintain multiple accounts
Trainer Verification
Trainers must provide valid certification and professional credentials. We reserve the right to:
Verify certification authenticity
Conduct background checks as required by law
Suspend accounts pending verification
Remove uncertified trainers from the platform
Account Termination
Either party may terminate an account at any time. Upon termination, you will lose access to the platform, but certain obligations under these Terms will survive termination.
User Conduct and Responsibilities
Acceptable Use
You agree to use TrainZilla only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. You agree NOT to:

Impersonate any person or entity or misrepresent your credentials
Upload harmful, offensive, or inappropriate content
Spam or send unsolicited communications to users
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems
Interfere with the proper working of the platform
Collect user information without consent
Use the platform for any commercial purpose other than providing fitness services
Professional Standards (For Trainers)
Maintain current professional certifications and licenses
Provide safe and appropriate fitness guidance
Respect client privacy and confidentiality
Follow professional ethics and standards
Comply with all applicable health and safety regulations
Content Standards
All content uploaded to the platform must comply with Indian decency standards and cultural sensitivities. Content that promotes discrimination, hatred, or violence will be removed immediately.
Payment Terms and Billing
Subscription Plans
All subscription fees are listed in Indian Rupees (₹)
Fees are billed monthly or annually as selected
GST will be added as applicable under Indian tax law
Price changes will be communicated 30 days in advance
No refunds for partial months unless required by law
Payment Methods
We accept the following payment methods in India:
UPI (PhonePe, GPay, Paytm, BHIM)
Credit and Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay)
Net Banking from major Indian banks
Digital wallets (Paytm, MobiKwik)
Bank transfers and NEFT/RTGS
Late Payments and Suspension
If payment is not received within 7 days of the due date, your account may be suspended. Accounts suspended for more than 30 days may be terminated and data deleted.
Trainer Payments
Trainers using our payment processing services will receive payments minus applicable platform fees, payment processing charges, and TDS as required by Indian income tax law.

Privacy and Data Protection

Your privacy is important to us. Our Privacy Policy, which is incorporated by reference into these Terms, explains how we collect, use, and protect your information in compliance with Indian data protection laws.

Any dispute arising out of or relating to these Terms shall be resolved through binding arbitration conducted in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 2015. The arbitration shall be conducted in Pune, Maharashtra, India, and the language of arbitration shall be English or Hindi as agreed by the parties.

Before initiating formal proceedings, we encourage users to contact our support team to resolve disputes informally. Many issues can be resolved quickly through direct communication.

We may update these Terms from time to time to reflect changes in our services, legal requirements, or business practices. Material changes will be communicated through:
